score_objections.objection: The only ai_risk evidence is a single 'win the AI race' line inside a data-center interview. Nothing in the sources addresses AI safety, model rules, or guardrails on AI systems; his conditions (no subsidies, water, farmland, ratepayers) are data-center siting conditions, not AI risk regulation. Evidence is too thin to place him at -1 Targeted guardrails; if anything the race framing leans light-touch. Suggest no position until an AI-specific source exists.

score_objections.objection: None of the sources touches semiconductor export controls or chip sales. The only China evidence is a DeepSeek federal-device ban and generic 'stay ahead of adversaries like China' rhetoric, which every senator in both parties uses. That is too thin to place him on the export-control scale; leaning hawkish is an inference, not a documented position.
